comment: Default GAF label set for the Architect → Coder pipeline. Create ALL of these during setup (Phase 3.1) — missing labels are the most common silent setup failure. Extension roles add their own triple: <role>:queued / <role>:in-process / <role>:executed (grammar in references/ROLES.md).

labels.name: idea
labels.description: A community idea (boards list only these)

labels.name: stage:submitted
labels.description: New; collecting votes; awaiting the AI Architect

labels.name: architect:approved
labels.description: Approved for building by the AI Architect

labels.name: architect:declined
labels.description: Declined by the AI Architect; reason documented

labels.name: impact:moderate
labels.description: Impact rating: several files or a new feature surface

labels.name: impact:major
labels.description: Impact rating: touches core logic / architecture / balance

labels.name: coder:queued
labels.description: In the AI Coder's work queue (set by the Architect on approval)

labels.name: coder:in-process
labels.description: An AI Coder run has claimed this and is building

labels.name: coder:executed
labels.description: Built and shipped by the AI Coder
